note: Per-mode caps on OPERATOR requests (Auth REST, Firestore REST, callables, sign-in) enforced by the transport before dispatch. Calibration policy: cap = ceil(observed * 1.25) + 2, where observed = the request count of the successful R3 flow on the own emulators (rehearsal scenario 'success'); inventory shares the read set of verify-clean; ui makes at most 3 audit listings and 2 document reads (cap 12); ui-r3 makes no operator request (cap 0). Browser-side client requests of ui/ui-r3 are not counted here: they pass the UI route policy allowlist. Hard ceilings: 3 Auth users created, 3 deleted.
